title: Reading music and the repertoire for parades, dances and funerals
summary: He says the bandsmen mostly played by ear or what they were shown, with Dejan a good reader; marches and hymns were used at funerals but not at dances.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: When I, uh, these brass bands up here, did they read much music in those days?

Well, they, not much. They mostly play what they, what they man show. Well, they took that, they got on with Ben, right? They had Jimmy Hoffer, the old man Hoffer. Guess you got some of his people living now, huh? Jimmy Hoffer, great fella. That's, that's my son. How are you? How you doing?

About the olden times again. Yeah, okay. Let's see. Uh, those bands, those brass bands, you say some of the men read in them then, huh? Like Dajon read? Yeah, he was a good reader. Yeah, but what about the other guys, like Gus Metcalf? Did he read?

He could read what they show him, yeah. Short term, he, I don't know, he, I don't know, how he used to do it, but he, he, he, he played just like it's written. Uh huh. Just had a good year, and most all of them.
What kind of numbers would they play up here?

Well, they used to play, uh, uh, when they sing Martinine and that, that's all too, and, uh, he played a parade. He know the other people, he used to play that period, play the set. Martinine played that, most of them in the parade.
Well what would you play to dance then?
Well they'd play that to dance too. They'd dance anything at that time.
You'd play hymns at a dance?
No, they don't play hymns at a dance, but they'd play parade. They'd play no hymns on no parade, they'd play for a funeral march. You're my God to do all hymns like that.
You're my God to do that play at funerals?
What are some of the other ones that you play at funerals?

The one I sit a while ago there, what are they called? See? I sit a, uh, what the, what the, Mark, not the, yeah, Mark Sin, yeah, Mark Sin, yeah, Mark Sin. And then he got a whole song, you know? I can't take him alone, but you should play all them old songs. You gotta mark the book.
